name: PostScore
definition: A post's numeric score value.

name: PostViewCount
definition: Number of views a post has received.

name: PostLanguage
definition: Programming language tag associated with a post.

name: UserReputation
definition: A user's reputation score.

name: UserAge
definition: A user's age in years.

name: UserDisplayName
definition: The display name of a user.

name: BadgeCount
definition: Number of badges a user has been awarded.

name: VoteId
definition: Identifier of a vote record.

name: VoteDate
definition: Timestamp when a vote was cast.

name: PostClosedStatus
definition: Whether a post is closed (null means not closed).

name: BountyAmount
definition: Bounty amount attached to a post.

name: FavoriteCount
definition: Number of times a post was favorited.

name: ElderUserPostCount
definition: Count of posts owned by users older than 65. Formula: COUNT(PostScore) WHERE UserAge > 65. Inputs: PostScore = tab05.fld006; UserAge = tab07.fld048 WHERE fld048 > 65

name: HighScorePostPercentage
definition: Share of posts whose score exceeds a threshold. Formula: COUNT(PostScore > threshold) / COUNT(PostScore) * 100. Inputs: PostScore = tab05.fld006

name: RLanguagePostPercentage
definition: Share of posts tagged with the R language. Formula: COUNT(PostLanguage='r') / COUNT(PostLanguage) * 100. Inputs: PostLanguage = tab06.fld034 WHERE fld034 = 'r'

name: AveragePostScore
definition: Average score across a set of posts. Formula: AVG(PostScore). Inputs: PostScore = tab05.fld006

name: TotalPostViews
definition: Sum of view counts across posts. Formula: SUM(PostViewCount). Inputs: PostViewCount = tab05.fld018

name: MaxUserReputation
definition: Maximum reputation value among users. Formula: MAX(UserReputation). Inputs: UserReputation = tab07.fld038

name: FirstVoteDate
definition: Earliest vote timestamp for a user. Formula: MIN(VoteDate). Inputs: VoteDate = tab04.fld008

name: PostPopularity
definition: Popularity of a post measured by view count. Formula: MAX(SUM(PostViewCount)). Inputs: PostViewCount = tab05.fld018

name: UserReputation
definition: Questions about user reputation and influence ranking.

name: PostLanguage
definition: Questions about programming languages used in posts.
